description: This file defines an abstract class 'Command' within the 'OrangeHRM\Framework\Console' namespace, extending Symfony's console Command class. It provides additional methods to handle input and output styling and mandates a method to retrieve the command name.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: An abstract base class for console commands in the OrangeHRM framework, extending Symfony's command and adding standardized input/output handling.

methods.name: getIO
methods.description: Returns the SymfonyStyle instance used for input and output styling.

methods.name: setIO
methods.description: Initializes the SymfonyStyle instance with given input and output interfaces.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up the input/output styling before executing the command logic by invoking the parent run method.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to specify their command name.
